items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I remember we played a show at the Oriental Theater with Earl Hines, and that show was Milton Berle. But nobody knew much about him then.

ctx.x: to his room. Yeah, this -- this -- I forgot the name. Isn't that strange -- of that little hotel. But anybody would know it. It was right -- it was the only place you could stay almost around in there. A lot of those bands would come and play the Regal Theater, and the Regal Theater had good shows in there all the time.

And Chicago was alive in those days. I remember we played a show at the Oriental Theater with Earl Hines, and that show was Milton Berle. But nobody knew much about him then. You know, he was very young then. And his mother used to come around all the shows where he was then. But he was on the show. This was when all the theaters used to have shows. The Oriental Theater and all the other theaters.

Earl used to like to go out and play a lot. Earl would. It was fun when we played with Earl because he'd say let's go out and play -- a few of us -- this place or that place. And we'd go out after we got through work and play all night.
